column3: NASB renders “all the things” as “all that.”
NASB reorders the verse and adds “to heaven.”
NASB adds “convincing” and “over a period of.”
NASB renders “instructed” as “commanded” and adds “He said” to mark the shift to direct speech.
NASB renders “not after many these days” as “not many days from now.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders the question “if” as “is it.”
NASB renders “seasons” as “epochs” and “put in place” as “has fixed.”
NASB follows the critical text (“My witnesses”); “uttermost part” is rendered “remotest part.”
NASB renders “hid Him from their eyes” as “received Him out of their sight.”
NASB follows the critical text (“white clothing”); “heaven” is rendered “sky.”
NASB renders “heaven” as “sky” once and adds “just the same.”
NASB renders “a Sabbath day’s journey” with “away.”
NASB moves “the upper room” to “went up to” and adds “that is.”
NASB follows the critical text without “and supplication”; “steadfastly continuing” is rendered “continually devoting themselves.”
NASB follows the critical text (“brethren”) and puts the number in parentheses; “names” is rendered “persons.”
NASB follows the critical text without “this”; “Men brothers” is rendered “Brethren.”
NASB follows the critical text; “allotted the share” is rendered “received his portion.”
NASB opens a parenthesis (to v. 19); “reward of unrighteousness” is rendered “price of his wickedness.”
NASB closes the parenthesis; it spells “Hakeldama.”
NASB follows the critical text; “position” is rendered “office.” The quotations are in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text.
Close to the Greek.
NASB adds “men” and puts “who was also called Justus” in parentheses.
NASB adds “men.”
NASB follows the critical text; “take the place” is rendered “occupy.”
NASB follows the critical text; “numbered with” is rendered “added to.”
